name: Okie cache policy
description: Edge-cache the static marketing pages, never cache live or private paths

rules.description: Cache HTML pages at the edge; origin sets the TTL via CDN-Cache-Control
Static assets: one year at the edge (filenames and ?v= are versioned)
Never cache: live booking page, form/telemetry API, admin inbox, writes
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/book") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"})
